sections.heading: The Fear Story Everyone's Missing
sections.body: This study from Theregister.com says 1 in 5 Brits think AI layoffs could trigger civil unrest. People don't think this AI thing is gonna end well for anyone except the people already at the top. But here's what nobody's talking about: while everyone else is worried, there's this small group of workers quietly building the biggest advantage they've ever had. They're not waiting around to see what happens. They figured out AI automation. And they're pulling ahead fast.

sections.heading: The Real Story: AI Skills Create Winners
sections.body:
It's not about AI replacing humans. It's about humans who get AI replacing everyone else.

Every time something big shifts, you get two groups: people who adapt early, and people who get left behind. Internet. Mobile. Cloud stuff. Same thing every time.

AI is the same playbook. Except this one's happening faster and the gaps between winners and everyone else are gonna be bigger.
